summary: Added a centralized update system with safe startup checks, optional notices, and mandatory blocking for versions considered unsafe.
changelog: Checks the validated GitHub version manifest at every application startup.
Keeps optional updates non-blocking while the application continues its normal initialization.
Blocks the synchronization runtime when a newer release is marked as mandatory.
Adds a manual update check to the About screen.
Uses SemVer precedence instead of comparing version strings.
Validates the JSON schema, required fields, response size, plain-text content, and UTC release timestamp.
Handles connection, GitHub, HTTP, download, and invalid-manifest failures without blocking normal startup.
Shows an elegant Libadwaita update window with version details, UTC release date, short summary, and an expandable full changelog.
